3. Seller performance

Sellers with ≥20 delivered orders are scored 0.5 × on-time rate + 0.5 × (average review ÷ 5) and split at the median of revenue and of score (analytics.v_seller_quadrant, KPI-consistent basis). Medians are relative to this platform, not absolute quality bars.

4. Customer retention

Customers are people (customer_unique_id). Lifetime-spend tiers: top 5% ≥ R$420 (≈ 95th percentile), mid R$90–420, low < R$90 of delivered item spend.

Read the lifetime-spend gradient as descriptive, not causal. Grouped by the value of their first order — before any repeat could happen — high spenders repeat slightly less often than low spenders. Neither view shows that a retention campaign would work; that needs a controlled test.
